name: hotelpro
description: HotelPro - modern hotel management platform (React + Express + MongoDB + JWT)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }))"
